note: All signing keys are published TEST-ONLY keys derived from fixed seeds in build_vectors.py. Never sign real artifacts with them.

cases.name: valid_py
cases.description: Signed artifact, no trust-layer extras. Must verify VALID.

cases.name: cross_implementation_rust
cases.description: Case 01's artifact verified by the Rust reader, and a Rust-produced signed artifact verified by the Python reader. Requires a Rust toolchain (cargo).

cases.name: tampered
cases.description: Payload byte flipped, checksum repaired. The signature cannot be recomputed by the attacker: INVALID.

cases.name: unsigned
cases.description: No signature chunk. Must report UNSIGNED, never VALID.

cases.name: revoked_list
cases.description: Signer's signed revocation supplied as a revocation-list file. Signature stays valid; trust status is REVOKED.

cases.name: revoked_embedded
cases.description: The same revocation embedded in the REVOCATION chunk. REVOKED; the artifact's §7.2 signature still verifies.

cases.name: forged_revocation
cases.description: Revocation statement for this artifact signed by a non-signer key. Must be ignored for trust (artifact stays VALID) and flagged: forged_revocations == 1.

cases.name: timestamp_verified
cases.description: TSA countersignature present; verifier has the TSA's pinned key (aux/tsa_pub.json). Timestamp verified.

cases.name: timestamp_unverified_authority
cases.description: Same artifact as 08, but the verifier has no pinned key for the TSA. Timestamp unverified — not a failure.

cases.name: crossdoc_resolved
cases.description: Downstream artifact references a node in the upstream artifact; the upstream artifact is supplied in the local bundle. Reference resolves.

cases.name: crossdoc_unresolved
cases.description: Same downstream artifact, no bundle supplied. The reference reports UNRESOLVED; the artifact's own trust status is unaffected (VALID).

cases.name: hybrid_valid
cases.description: Hybrid ed25519+ml-dsa-65 signed artifact (SPEC 7.9). Strict hybrid verification (require_pq gate mode): both components valid -> VALID. Executed by the pq_hybrid adapter (spif.trust, require_pq).

cases.name: hybrid_tampered_ml_dsa
cases.description: ML-DSA-65 component byte flipped, checksum repaired. Hybrid verification requires BOTH components -> INVALID.

cases.name: hybrid_tampered_ed25519
cases.description: ed25519 component byte flipped, checksum repaired. Hybrid verification requires BOTH components -> INVALID.

cases.name: hybrid_ed25519_only_relabelled
cases.description: ed25519-only signature with the algorithm field relabelled to ed25519+ml-dsa-65 (64-byte signature, no ML-DSA component). The hybrid verifier must reject it -> INVALID.

cases.name: neg_duplicate_signer_key
cases.description: SIGNATURE map carries the `signer` key twice (attacker first, victim last). A last-wins decoder attributes the document to the victim; a first-wins decoder to the attacker. Ambiguous in any document: must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_duplicate_signature_key
cases.description: SIGNATURE map carries the `signature` key twice (garbage first, genuine second). Whether the entry verifies depends on the decoder's duplicate-key rule: ambiguous, must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_indefinite_signature_map
cases.description: SIGNATURE chunk re-encoded as an indefinite-length CBOR map. A signed document's chunks must be canonical (SPEC §4.1 / §12.4): must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_longform_signature_header
cases.description: SIGNATURE map header in the non-minimal long form (0xB8) although the pair count fits the short form. Non-canonical in a signed document: must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_trailing_bytes_after_checksum
cases.description: Bytes appended after the terminal CHECKSUM chunk (SPEC §12.4: CHECKSUM is last). The extra bytes are outside the document's identity and must not be silently ignored into the same verdict: must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_duplicate_key_provenance
cases.description: PROVENANCE map carries `source_model` twice. The ambiguity rule is class-level, not SIGNATURE-only: a duplicate key in any chunk of a signed document must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_hybrid_malformed_length_classical
cases.description: Case 15's artifact (ed25519-only signature relabelled ed25519+ml-dsa-65, 64 bytes) assessed under the CLASSICAL gate (default adapter; case 15 pins the require_pq gate). §7.9.2: a hybrid entry not exactly 3373 bytes is malformed and INVALID in BOTH modes — the classical reader must not fall back to verifying its ed25519 component.

cases.name: neg_pq_only_classical_unverifiable
cases.description: Genuinely ML-DSA-65-signed artifact read by a classical reader. §7.9.2: a PQ-only entry is invisible, not invalid, to a classical reader — the verdict is UNVERIFIABLE, never VALID and never INVALID.

cases.name: neg_crossauth_multisig_appended
cases.description: Single-signature artifact plus an appended MULTISIG chunk carrying a second signer's entry, genuinely signed over the public signing body with the CHECKSUM recomputed. SPEC §7.2: one document, one attestation — SIGNATURE and MULTISIG must not co-exist, or their entries union into a signer set no signer attested (SPIF-CROSSAUTH-SIGNER-EXPANSION-001): must not verify VALID.

cases.name: neg_crossauth_signature_appended
cases.description: Genuine two-signer MULTISIG artifact plus an appended SIGNATURE chunk carrying a third signer's entry, genuinely signed over the public signing body with the CHECKSUM recomputed. The reverse direction of case 24: co-present auth chunk types must not verify VALID (SPEC §7.2).
